## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-502-01` — The packaged helper path is used consistently and a moved, missing, or replaced helper produces a repairable state rather than silent success.
- `AC-502-02` — Receipts permit removal only while the current owned entry still matches; user modifications create a conflict instead of destructive rollback.
- `AC-502-03` — A mixed multi-client run reports successes and failures independently and remains safe to repeat.
